result.summary: The home screen has several layout and content problems: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a broken-looking 0% discount badge, and cards that are clipped at the edges.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in Fastest near you is cut off on the right, and the name “Trattoria Piccol” is truncated without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal cards show a peek of the next item consistently and truncate names with an ellipsis so they remain readable.

issues.description: The last category chip (“Healthy”) is clipped by the screen edge, making the filter row look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or a fade so chips aren’t cut off, or allow the row to scroll with a clear overflow affordance.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a “-0%” badge, which looks like a missing or zero discount rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0, or show a meaningful promotion instead of “-0%”.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is cut off by the tab bar, so the item is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area spacing so the last card isn’t hidden behind the navigation bar.

issues.description: The promo banner uses a long promo code and conditions that wrap awkwardly on the green card.
issues.suggestion: Shorten the copy or stack the code and min-order line so it remains easy to scan.
